notes:
Source: Moovit crowd-mapped ordered stop lists for the Sião Thur Macapá–Santana intercity/urban bus corridor. The two given index URLs render client-side (returned empty via WebFetch), so I pulled the authoritative data from Moovit's offline map PDFs (appassets.mvtdev.com/map/131/l/5380/{687458,687459,687461}.pdf), which contain the FULL ordered stop lists. Built the operator's three flagship documented Macapá–Santana routes: 300 (Via KM-9, 108 stops, 150 min), 500 (Via Fazendinha, 102 stops, 140 min), 600 (Via Coração, 99 stops, 145 min). Each is a terminal-to-terminal loop (starts and ends at Terminal Rodoviário de Santana), so one representative daily trip per route is emitted in the single published direction (dir 0); the PDFs only publish one itinerary per line. Sião Thur reportedly runs 17 routes / 468 stops total; only these 3 corridor lines have published ordered stop lists + times, so the remaining ~14 informal feeder routes are NOT included (no evidenced stop data).

STOP COORDINATES: Moovit PDFs give ordered stop NAMES but no coordinates. Terminals and major named landmarks (Terminal Rodoviário de Santana, Mercado Central de Macapá, Praça Barão do Rio Branco, Prefeitura, UNIFAP/Rod. JK, IAPEN/Cabralzinho on Rod. Duca Serra, IFAP, Cemitério São Francisco, DETRAN, Terminal Fortaleza) were geocoded from Wikipedia/Wikidata/OSM/known WGS-84 references (e.g. Mercado Central 0.03083,-51.05361; Fortaleza 0.0311,-51.0491). Intermediate numbered-address stops (Rodovia Duca Serra NNN, Ap-440 NNN, etc.) were linearly INTERPOLATED along the corridor between the nearest anchored landmarks in stop_sequence order — plausible positions on the correct Santana→Macapá axis (~19-25 km NW corridor) but not surveyed points. All coordinates verified inside the Macapá/Santana bounding box (lat -0.06..0.05, lon -51.20..-51.03). Treat interpolated stop_lat/lon as approximate (±few hundred m); anchor landmarks are accurate.

SERVICE TIMES: Published span is 05:30–21:30 Mon–Fri, 06:00–18:30 Sat, 05:50–18:30 Sun (identical for all 3 lines per Moovit). Moovit gives only the operating window + trip duration, not a departure grid, so the representative trip's stop_times were laid down as an even distribution across each line's published door-to-door duration starting at 05:30. Calendar = daily (all 7 days), 2026 full year.

Referential integrity validated: every stop_time references a valid trip_id and stop_id; stop_sequence monotonic; times non-decreasing within each trip; identical stop names shared across routes via one stop registry (230 unique stops across 300/500/600). Files written to /home/ubuntu/adresses/gtfs_siao_thur/ (agency.txt, stops.txt, routes.txt, trips.txt, stop_times.txt, calendar.txt). This is a bus operator (route_type 3) — no metro/rail/BRT exists for this operator, so the metro-first guidance does not apply.
